lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, with the highest concentration appearing in the mid-flank region between the pectoral fin and the upper ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting with the circular blobs to form a subtle, irregular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a light-colored dorsal surface to a darker, shadowed region immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of approximately five to six parallel, vertical, high-luminance linear scars are clearly visible on the flank immediately posterior to the gill slits.
